description.value: Counselling services provided by trained professionals, for people with mental health conditions such as anxiety, depression or eating disorders and for people experiencing difficult life events.

interpretation_services.value: Interpretation services are available in Urdu, Polish and Slovak.

fees_description.value: Free for NHS patients. Other people pay a flat rate of GBP 50 per hour of counselling.
